comparison.objective: Measure shaft end play, select and fit a split spacer, then verify the corrected play.
comparison.physical_skill: Instrument referencing, controlled shaft motion, measurement-based part selection, spacer installation, and remeasurement.
comparison.success_condition: Valid initial and final readings, 2–4 mm final clearance, agreement within 0.5 mm, retained spacer, shaft rotation, and 2 s stability are required.
comparison.reason: Metrology-guided fit correction tests measurement and part selection, not extraction of a latched electrical contact.
